content:
<thought>Retrieve polymorphs for a representative list of sulfide compositions.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "FeS", "CuS", "ZnS", "MoS2", "WS2", "NiS", "CoS", "SnS", "PbS", "CdS",
        "GaS", "InS", "Bi2S3", "Ag2S", "Al2S3", "SiS2", "GeS2", "TiS2", "V2S5", "NbS2",
        "TaS2", "ZrS2", "HfS2", "MnS", "CrS", "FeS2", "Cu2S", "CuS2", "Sb2S3", "MgS",
        "CaS", "SrS", "BaS", "K2S", "Na2S", "Li2S", "Cs2S", "Rb2S", "Y2S3", "Sc2S3"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "sulfides_data"
}</action_input>

<thought>Consolidate the individual polymorph JSON files into a single dataset.</thought>
<action>consolidate_polymorph_datasets</action>
<action_input>{
    "composition_files": {
        "FeS": "sulfides_data/FeS_polymorphs.json",
        "CuS": "sulfides_data/CuS_polymorphs.json",
        "ZnS": "sulfides_data/ZnS_polymorphs.json",
        "MoS2": "sulfides_data/MoS2_polymorphs.json",
        "WS2": "sulfides_data/WS2_polymorphs.json",
        "NiS": "sulfides_data/NiS_polymorphs.json",
        "CoS": "sulfides_data/CoS_polymorphs.json",
        "SnS": "sulfides_data/SnS_polymorphs.json",
        "PbS": "sulfides_data/PbS_polymorphs.json",
        "CdS": "sulfides_data/CdS_polymorphs.json",
        "GaS": "sulfides_data/GaS_polymorphs.json",
        "InS": "sulfides_data/InS_polymorphs.json",
        "Bi2S3": "sulfides_data/Bi2S3_polymorphs.json",
        "Ag2S": "sulfides_data/Ag2S_polymorphs.json",
        "Al2S3": "sulfides_data/Al2S3_polymorphs.json",
        "SiS2": "sulfides_data/SiS2_polymorphs.json",
        "GeS2": "sulfides_data/GeS2_polymorphs.json",
        "TiS2": "sulfides_data/TiS2_polymorphs.json",
        "V2S5": "sulfides_data/V2S5_polymorphs.json",
        "NbS2": "sulfides_data/NbS2_polymorphs.json",
        "TaS2": "sulfides_data/TaS2_polymorphs.json",
        "ZrS2": "sulfides_data/ZrS2_polymorphs.json",
        "HfS2": "sulfides_data/HfS2_polymorphs.json",
        "MnS": "sulfides_data/MnS_polymorphs.json",
        "CrS": "sulfides_data/CrS_polymorphs.json",
        "FeS2": "sulfides_data/FeS2_polymorphs.json",
        "Cu2S": "sulfides_data/Cu2S_polymorphs.json",
        "CuS2": "sulfides_data/CuS2_polymorphs.json",
        "Sb2S3": "sulfides_data/Sb2S3_polymorphs.json",
        "MgS": "sulfides_data/MgS_polymorphs.json",
        "CaS": "sulfides_data/CaS_polymorphs.json",
        "SrS": "sulfides_data/SrS_polymorphs.json",
        "BaS": "sulfides_data/BaS_polymorphs.json",
        "K2S": "sulfides_data/K2S_polymorphs.json",
        "Na2S": "sulfides_data/Na2S_polymorphs.json",
        "Li2S": "sulfides_data/Li2S_polymorphs.json",
        "Cs2S": "sulfides_data/Cs2S_polymorphs.json",
        "Rb2S": "sulfides_data/Rb2S_polymorphs.json",
        "Y2S3": "sulfides_data/Y2S3_polymorphs.json",
        "Sc2S3": "sulfides_data/Sc2S3_polymorphs.json"
    },
    "output_path": "consolidated_sulfides.json"
}</action_input>

<thought>Prepare a tabular dataset with advanced feature engineering, normalization, and a 20 % test split.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "consolidated_sulfides.json",
    "output_path": "sulfide_ml",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>

<thought>Train the XGBoost model using the provided hyperparameters.</thought>
<action>train_xgboost_model</action>
<action_input>{
    "train_data_path": "sulfide_ml/train.csv",
    "test_data_path": "sulfide_ml/test.csv",
    "model_save_path": "sulfide_ml/xgb_model.pkl",
    "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "hyperparameters": {
        "n_estimators": 200,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1
    }
}</action_input>

<thought>Evaluate the trained model on the test set with detailed analysis.</thought>
<action>evaluate_xgboost_model</action>
<action_input>{
    "model_path": "sulfide_ml/xgb_model.pkl",
    "test_data_path": "sulfide_ml/test.csv",
    "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "detailed_analysis": true
}</action_input>

<thought>Perform 5‑fold cross‑validation on the training data using the same hyperparameters.</thought>
<action>perform_cross_validation</action>
<action_input>{
    "train_data_path": "sulfide_ml/train.csv",
    "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "cv_folds": 5,
    "hyperparameters": {
        "n_estimators": 200,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1
    }
}</action_input>

<thought>Combine the evaluation and cross‑validation results into the required JSON structure and write it to the final results file.</thought>
<action>write_file</action>
<action_input>{
    "path": "model_evaluation_results.json",
    "content": "{\n  \"test_set_evaluation\": {\n    \"mae\": {{evaluate_xgboost_model_output.mae}},\n    \"rmse\": {{evaluate_xgboost_model_output.rmse}},\n    \"r2\": {{evaluate_xgboost_model_output.r2}},\n    \"feature_importance\": {{evaluate_xgboost_model_output.feature_importance}}\n  },\n  \"cross_validation_results\": {\n    \"r2_mean\": {{perform_cross_validation_output.r2_mean}},\n    \"r2_std\": {{perform_cross_validation_output.r2_std}}\n  }\n}\n"
}</action_input>
